    global cur
    p=np.array(p,float)

+            t2, t3 = t*t, t*t*t

+                       + (-p0+3*p1-3*p2+p3)*t3)
+            out.append(p)
+    out.append(c[-1])
+    a = np.asarray(out)
+    a[:, 2] = np.maximum(a[:, 2], 0.15)
+    return a
+
+
+def append_segment(rows: list[np.ndarray], start: np.ndarray, end: np.ndarray,
+                   q: np.ndarray, spacing: float = 0.006) -> np.ndarray:
+    end = np.asarray(end, dtype=np.float64)
+    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(end - start) / spacing)))
+    for p in np.linspace(start, end, n + 1)[1:]:
+        rows.append(np.r_[p, q])
+    return end
+
+
+def pen_command(r: Robot, rows: list[np.ndarray], note: str, out_name: str):
+    actions = np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32)
+    if len(actions) > 200:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"{len(actions)} rows exceeds the 10 second chunk limit")
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", actions, dt=DT,
+                   cameras=("canvas_cam", "scene_cam", "side_cam"),
+                   video="none", note=note)
+    nfail = sum(int(p.get("ik_failures", 0)) for p in res.meta.get("plan", []))
+    print({"note": note, "rows": len(actions), "sim_s": round(len(actions)*DT, 2),
+           "ik_failures": nfail, "clipped": res.meta.get("n_clipped"),
+           "time_left_s": res.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+           "tip": res.proprio[-1, 7:10].round(4).tolist()})
+    if out_name:
+        res.save(out_name)
+    if res.done or nfail:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"episode done or IK failed: {res.meta.get('reason')}")
+    return res
+
+
+def ink(r: Robot):
+    o = r.get_obs(video="none")
+    now = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float64)
+    cur = now[7:10].copy()
+    q = Q_DOWN.copy()
+    rows: list[np.ndarray] = []
+    cur = append_segment(rows, cur, [cur[0], cur[1], 0.075], q)
+    cur = append_segment(rows, cur, [-0.100, 0.150, 0.075], q)
+    cur = append_segment(rows, cur, [-0.100, 0.150, 0.024], q)
+    rows.extend([np.r_[cur, q]] * 12)
+    cur = append_segment(rows, cur, [-0.100, 0.150, 0.075], q)
+    cur = append_segment(rows, cur, PARK, q)
+    pen_command(r, rows, "fresh ink dip and retreat", "/app/runs/main_ink")
+
+
+def draw_one(r: Robot, idx: int):
+    obs = r.get_obs(video="none")
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float64)
+    cur = now[7:10].copy()
+    q = Q_DOWN.copy()
+    uv0 = STROKES[idx][0]
+    x0, y0 = pixel_to_world(uv0[0], uv0[1])
+    rows: list[np.ndarray] = []
+
+    # Approach with the tip clear of both sheets; only the traced path touches.
+    cur = append_segment(rows, cur, [cur[0], cur[1], 0.080], q)
+    cur = append_segment(rows, cur, [x0, y0, 0.080], q)
+    start_depth = max(0.25, STROKES[idx][0][2])
+    cur = append_segment(rows, cur, [x0, y0, SHEET_Z - start_depth/1000.0], q,
+                         spacing=0.0025)
+    rows.extend([np.r_[cur, q]] * 2)
+
+    for u, v, depth in catmull_rom(STROKES[idx]):
+        x, y = pixel_to_world(float(u), float(v))
+        cur = np.array([x, y, SHEET_Z - float(depth)/1000.0])
+        rows.append(np.r_[cur, q])
+    # Lift cleanly, then park above the ink stone so the sheet is visible.
+    cur = append_segment(rows, cur, [cur[0], cur[1], 0.080], q,
+                         spacing=0.003)
+    cur = append_segment(rows, cur, [cur[0], cur[1], 0.120], q)
+    cur = append_segment(rows, cur, [-0.100, 0.150, 0.120], q)
+    cur = append_segment(rows, cur, PARK, q)
+    pen_command(r, rows, f"main-sheet exemplar stroke {idx}/8",
+                f"/app/runs/main_stroke_{idx:02d}")
+
+
+def main():
+    if len(sys.argv) != 2 or sys.argv[1] not in {"ink", "all", *map(str, STROKES)}:
+        raise SystemExit("usage: gen.py ink | 1..8 | all")
+    r = Robot()
+    mode = sys.argv[1]
+    if mode == "ink":
+        ink(r)
+    elif mode == "all":
+        ink(r)
+        for i in STROKES:
+            draw_one(r, i)
+    else:
+        draw_one(r, int(mode))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
